title.context: Budget tab: heading of the card listing what the month's plan sends to savings goals, IKE accounts and loan repayments, each with a 'Pay in' button.

done.context: From the paycheck card: progress in the corner.

payBack.context: From the paycheck: a loan instalment line; {note} is what was borrowed for.

aLoan.context: From the paycheck: used as {note} when the loan has no description.

to.context: From the paycheck: under a loan instalment, which goal or account it goes back to. Lowercase.

savings.context: From the paycheck: used as {name} in 'to {name}' when the goal or account is gone. Lowercase.

paidBackNote.context: Note saved on the deposit made when an instalment is paid in; shows in the savings history.

closed.context: From the paycheck: name shown for a line whose goal or account was deleted.

onto.context: From the paycheck: which account the money goes onto. Lowercase fragment.

noAccount.context: From the paycheck: the goal has no account chosen yet. Lowercase fragment.

account.context: From the paycheck: small label for a line paid straight into an account. Lowercase.

planNote.context: Note saved on a savings deposit made from the month's plan, e.g. 'October plan'; shows in the savings history.

unspent.context: From the paycheck: a line with the previous month's leftover; {month} is its name. Lowercase fragment.

shareUnspent.context: From the paycheck: this goal's percentage of the previous month's leftover. Lowercase fragment.

atEndOf.context: From the paycheck: the leftover can only be paid in once the month {month} is over. Lowercase fragment.

paidOf.context: From the paycheck: how much of a line is paid in.

paidIn.context: From the paycheck: the line is fully paid in.

payIn.context: From the paycheck: button that records the deposit (first tap).

confirm.context: From the paycheck: the same button asking for a second tap to confirm.

other.message: Do tego {amount} innych oszczędności, gdzie chcesz.
other.context: From the paycheck: savings in the plan not tied to a goal or account.

failed.context: From the paycheck: error; {error} is technical.
